messages:
alex: Quick sync — proposing a set of 'isolation signal' thresholds for multi-tenant routing. Goal: stop noisy tenants from degrading others with minimal customer impact. Short bullets below and actions.
maria: Can you list the signals? are we talking per-tenant QPS, error-rate, tails, or cost-per-token drift?
alex: Initial signals I'm proposing: cpu% on host, queue-depth, p99 latency > 1000ms for 2m, error rate > 0.5% for 1m, cost drift > 20% vs baseline. Each signal gets soft + hard actions. Example policy snippet: `{"signal":"p99_latency","threshold_ms":1000,"window":"2m","action":"soft_steer"}`
sam: How do actions map to rollout phases? Suggest soft -> steer to warm slices / reduce batch size; hard -> quarantine + rehome + alert.
ishaan: Launch criteria we should enforce: canary routing, metrics ingest for new signals, rollback path, and a customer opt-in toggle. Also need audit logging for every auto-action.
maria: A few customers are asking for per-customer isolation policy in the Console (manual override + audit). That needs product and UI work.
alex: Proposed SLOs for isolation transitions: time-to-steady-route <= 60s for soft steering, <= 5m for hard rehome. Also define error budget for false positives. Ops runbook mandatory.
sam: Practical note on cost: hard evictions will cause rehome churn and warmup; expect a 10-30% capacity tax during migration windows depending on model size. Plan for throttled migrations.
ishaan: Question: how aggressive should auto-evict be? For small noisy tenants we might prefer throttling instead of eviction. Maybe tie hard actions to contract tier: enterprise -> hard protections by default, free/seed -> conservative.
maria: Launch checklist we need: simulation tooling, migration dry-run mode, UI flags, policy API, and a pilot customer. Also legal + billing sign-off for cost implications.
alex: Action items: @maria draft PRD with scope + launch checklist; @sam run sims across 10k synthetic tenants to find thresholds; @ishaan prototype route-steering API and playback rehome plan.
deploy-bot: FYI: infra alert — canary slice-7 had p99 spikes ~90s yesterday (investigated).
sam: That's the exact pattern we want to catch with soft steering. We'll use that incident as a test case.
ishaan: Edge-case: streaming / long-running requests show transient p99 spikes but low customer impact. Need request classification to avoid false positives (exclude streaming-heavy signal by default).
maria: Agreed. Add a streaming-heavy flag and don't auto-hard-evict on those. Also add a note to UI to surface 'excluded signals' per tenant.
alex: Oscillation risk: propose hysteresis — require 3 consecutive windows breach before hard action, and cooldown windows after a change.
sam: +1. Without hysteresis we'll thrash and increase cost.
maria: Timeline: PRD by EOD Friday, pilot with customer X in 2 sprints, GA targeted for end of Q3 (tentative, dependent on pilot).
alex: Great. I'll start the runbook skeleton and post in #eng-ops docs. Anyone want to pair on the simulation definition later today?
ishaan: I'll join for the sims at 3pm.
maria: I'll start the PRD draft and wireframe the Console controls.
alex: Thanks all — keeping this thread for decision log. :thumbsup:
